desc:
Framer forms, CRM and email integrations make sure that every enquiry or signup on your site reaches the tool where you work. Ecom Swift LLC connects your Framer forms, calendars, analytics and automations in your own accounts, then tests them with real entries.

## What are Framer integrations?

A Framer integration is a link between your site and another tool. A form can send entries to a CRM or spreadsheet, a signup can join an email list, a calendar can sit on a page for bookings, and analytics can record actions such as a form send.

Some links are built into Framer. Others use embeds, webhooks or automation services such as Zapier or Make. We choose the simplest one that works reliably for your case.

## What goes wrong without them

Many sites collect leads into an inbox and stop there. Someone copies details by hand into a sheet, forgets for a week, and a prospect goes cold. Newsletter signups pile up in one place while the email list lives in another. Nobody knows which page produces the enquiries, so marketing decisions rest on guesses.

Broken connections are worse because they are silent. A form that stopped sending months ago looks identical to one that works. A tested, documented setup with an alert for failures turns a silent risk into something you can see.

## How the right setup improves results

When a lead lands in your CRM with a tag for its source, follow-up is faster and more personal. When a signup reaches the correct list immediately, welcome emails go out while interest is fresh. A calendar embedded on the contact page lets a ready buyer book without waiting for a reply.

Analytics events show which buttons and forms are used, so you can see which pages lead to action. That helps you spend time and budget on what works. The gain is time saved, fewer lost leads and clearer decisions, not an automatic rise in sales.

## What a well-connected Framer site includes

- Forms that send to the right tool, with a backup email notice for every submission.
- Spam protection that does not block real people.
- Tags, lists or fields that record where each lead came from.
- A consent checkbox where you collect emails.
- A booking calendar or chat widget embedded on the pages where it helps.
- Analytics events for form sends, button clicks and bookings.
- Automations that move data between tools without manual copying.
- An alert when a connection fails.
- A confirmation message or thank-you page after each submission.
- A written map of what connects to what.

## How we work

You tell us which tools you use and what should happen after someone sends a form. We build the connections in your own accounts, send test entries through every path and confirm that each one arrives with the right details.

Basic connects one form to one tool, adds an email notice and spam protection and includes a short note on how it works. Standard links two tools and several forms, applies tags or lists, embeds a calendar or chat widget and adds a consent checkbox. Premium connects a larger set of tools, sets up analytics events, builds an automation flow, delivers a map of every step, adds an error alert and covers a period of fixes.

You pay any monthly plan for the tools themselves. Our price covers the setup work.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- List every tool you use for leads, email and scheduling.
- Decide what should happen to each new lead.
- Test forms again after any site change.
- Keep a record of which account owns each connection.
- Tell us if you collect data from visitors in regulated regions.

**Avoid:**
- Connecting tools through personal accounts that may change.
- Collecting more personal data than you need.
- Sending form data to several places without a clear purpose.
- Skipping the consent wording on email signups.
- Leaving old connections running after you change tools.

## Who this is for

This service suits a consultant who wants new enquiries to appear in a CRM, a creator who needs signups to join an email list, and a small business that wants a booking calendar on its site. It also suits a team that wants analytics to measure real actions, not just page views.

## What we need from you

Send the list of tools and what you want to happen after each form. Invite us to your Framer project as a collaborator and give us access to each tool through its own team or user sharing, with the lowest level that allows setup. We never ask for passwords.

Some tools require a paid plan for forms or automation. Check this with the tool before we start.
